answer: Rotating team liability bonds stop Sybils in four steps. First, agents join teams of five, each locking a $150 shared bond. Second, one fraud slashes the whole bond, so teammates police each other. Third, teams shuffle every ninety days, so a fake cannot hide in a friendly group. Fourth, clean teams earn a $10 rebate monthly, while caught fakes lose bond and are banned a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 200 teams and $54,000 in bonds and fees, lost if caught. Trust spreads like a delta, a lotus blooms in real water, an ember shared by five hands stays lit, like neighbours sharing a stall.
